title: 第四十四章 风声第四十三章 好久不见
slug: 魔头别夺舍了我们正道快没人了
lines: “好久不见。”
季南北操控着身体，中规中矩地打了个招呼。
“哎呦呦!小剑仙居然主动跟我打招呼了!明明上次在台上都快把我打哭了，你都一句话没跟我说过呢。”
张清妙双眼放光，语气夸张地说道。
意识里，萧京溪无奈地向季南北解释道:
“她上次比试时，一登台就喋喋不休说个没完。本来按照惯例，双方该先互报姓名师承，可是......实在是......”
实在是让当时本就紧张的萧京溪更加难以招架。季南北表示理解。
“因为上一次乃是正式的擂台较技。身为修行之人，自当全神贯注，认真对待每一场比斗。”
季南北轻松地将此事一笔带过，理由充分又得体。
“也对也对，真不愧是小剑仙，觉悟就是高!哎呀，这么一想，输给你好像也不算太丢脸嘛。对了对了......“
季南北（内心）:这位的话是真多啊!
“她一向如此。不过也好，她自己就能把话题全说完，相处时反倒不需要我多说什么。”
萧京溪在意识中如此补充道。
季南北（操控身体）几不可察地轻轻扶额。
“对了，关于这次修界大比的具体消息，你们听说了吗?”
张清妙抛出这个问题，总算暂时刹住了她那滔滔不绝的话头。
季南北对此倒是颇感兴趣。
仙灵剑宗那边确实还未有详细消息传达下来。
“仙灵剑宗尚未正式公布细则，你已经知晓了?”
“嗯嗯，得到些风声了。这次修界大比，暂定名为‘拨云夺旗’。据说在最终的排名战之前，会先进行一次秘境群战，以此选拔出有资格参与最终排名战的选手。不过，你我就不用操心这个环节了。依照惯例，上一届九门夺魁的前三名，是可以直接保送进入最终排名战的。”
这名字听起来，似乎是指在秘境之季南北并未过分在意。
毕竟张清妙也提到了，萧京溪作为上届魁首，享有直接晋级最终排名战的资格。届时便是一对一的擂台较量。
那个时候，自然该由萧京溪本人亲自上场。
自己的比赛，当然要自己来打!
以萧京溪的实力，上届能力压群雄夺魁，此番想必也是胜券在握。
张清妙仍在继续分享着她所知的消息:
“上届九门夺魁的第二名，拜月魔宗那个家伙，今年年龄已经超过限制了，所以这次不会见到他了。咱俩这估计也是最后一次参与这盛会啦!上次你就压了我一头，这次我说什么也得把场子找回来，嘿嘿......”的事情。
“喂喂!不是吧!你......你竟然碎丹成婴，踏入元婴期了!?”
季南北颇感无奈。
他根本没有刻意隐藏修为（也不会隐藏之法），从进门到现在已有一段时间，这位张清妙道友居然才察觉到。
难不成方才她的注意力全放在说话上了?
“侥幸而已。”
content_en:
"Long time no see."
Ji Nanbei controlled his body and said hello in a decent manner.
"Ouch! Little Sword Fairy actually took the initiative to say hello to me! You almost made me cry on stage last time, but you didn't even say a word to me."
Zhang Qingmiao's eyes shone and she said in an exaggerated tone.
In his mind, Xiao Jingxi helplessly explained to Ji Nanbei:
"When she competed last time, she couldn't stop talking as soon as she took the stage. According to the usual practice, both parties should first announce each other's names and masters, but... it's really..."
It really made Xiao Jingxi, who was already nervous at the time, even more difficult to resist. Ji Nanbei expressed understanding.
"Because the last time was a formal competition in the ring. As a practitioner, you should concentrate on it and take every battle seriously."
Ji Nanbei brushed the matter off easily, with good and appropriate reasons.
"That's right, that's right. As expected of a little swordsman, he has a high level of consciousness! Oh, now that I think about it, it's not too embarrassing to lose to you. That's right, that's right..."
Ji Nanbei (innerly): This guy talks so much!
"She has always been like this. But it's okay, she can finish the whole topic by herself, and she doesn't need me to say anything when we get along."
Xiao Jingxi added this in his mind.
Ji Nanbei (controlling his body) gently held his forehead almost imperceptibly.
"By the way, have you heard the specific news about this cultivation competition?"
Zhang Qingmiao raised this question and finally stopped her rambling words temporarily.
Ji Nanbei was quite interested in this.
Indeed, no detailed information has been conveyed from the Fairy Sword Sect.
"The Fairy Spirit Sword Sect has not officially announced the details yet, do you already know about it?"
"Hmm, I got some rumors. This cultivation competition is tentatively named 'Pull the Clouds and Capture the Flag'. It is said that before the final ranking battle, there will be a secret group battle to select players who are qualified to participate in the final ranking battle. However, you and I don't have to worry about this link. According to the convention, the top three winners of the last nine gates can be directly recommended to enter the final ranking battle."
"Pull the clouds and capture the flag"...
The name sounds like it means that North and South did not pay too much attention to it in the season of secrets.
After all, Zhang Qingmiao also mentioned that Xiao Jingxi, as the leader of the previous term, has the qualification to directly advance to the final ranking battle. It will then be a one-on-one competition in the ring.
At that time, it was natural for Xiao Jingxi himself to take the stage.
Of course you have to play your own game!
With Xiao Jingxi's strength, he was able to dominate the competition and win the championship last time, and he must be sure to win this time.
Zhang Qingmiao continues to share the news she knows:
"The guy from the Moon Worshiping Demon Sect who came second in the last nine sects has exceeded the age limit this year, so we won't see him this time. This is probably the last time we will participate in this grand event! You overpowered me last time, this time I have to get back the place no matter what, hehe..."
"Hey, hey! That's not true! You...you actually broke the pill and became a baby, entering the Nascent Soul stage!?"
Ji Nanbei felt helpless.
He didn't deliberately hide his cultivation level at all (nor did he know how to hide it). It had been a while since he entered the door, and Taoist friend Zhang Qingmiao actually noticed it.
Could it be that just now her focus was entirely on talking?
"It was just a fluke."
title_en: Chapter 44: Rumor Chapter 43: Long time no see
